title: CompletionReconcileInput
description: INPUT of `completion_reconcile`: the raw agent verdict fields to normalize/reconcile into a completion_verdict (FAIL<->findings invariant + citation downgrade).

ticket_id.description: The canonical ticket id (for the verdict target).

raw_criteria.description: The agent's raw positive per-criterion records (carried through to the reconciled verdict).

runner.description: Runner id from the agent run.

model.description: Model id from the agent run.

trace_id.description: Trace id from the agent run.

provider_provenance.description: Provider provenance record from the agent run (resolved provider/model, the endpoint actually called, and the effective capability record). Carried from the verify step onto the verdict, never recomputed here. Null when the runner resolved no provider (e.g. the fake runner).

certifiable.description: From the precheck: false iff a closed-but-uncertified descendant withholds the parent's certification (the parent may close but not certify). Carried onto the verdict; defaults true.

verify_certifiable.description: From the verify step's own self-verdict provenance (2948): false when a banked deterministic fallback assembled the verdict without a model call. Combined (AND) with the precheck's `certifiable` so either source can withhold certification.

finalizer.description: How the verify step produced the verdict (primary / llm_finalizer / deterministic_fallback). Carried onto the verdict as its self-verdict provenance.

completion_prefetch_manifest.description: Identifiers for the prefetched evidence included in the verifier context, carried onto the verdict so COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecars can fingerprint the actual evidence set.
